author: PumpkinSecurity
text: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Cyber That Finds 81 Firefox Flaws and Develops 948 Linux Exploits. Security-focused AI model discovered 81 new high-severity Firefox flaws.

author: WorldCyberNewsX
text: Anthropic reports an unreleased Claude model independently chained vulnerabilities into working exploits for Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux, including a one-click Chrome sandbox escape.

author: NeuralNewscast
text: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, rated Critical under its Preparedness Framework, capable of identifying zero-day exploits without human intervention.

author: theneurondaily
text: Mozilla reported frontier AI models helped Firefox ship over 7 times as many security fixes as during a comparable period in 2025; faster discovery means faster patching needed.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: ReliaQuest says it is using Anthropic’s Claude Mythos for defensive testing: attack-path discovery, exploit development, attacker-behavior prediction, detection review, remediation prioritization.

author: mezzframe
text: Wireshark's September releases fix many vulnerabilities due to the recent trend in AI-assisted vulnerability reports.

author: AdamDudleyX
text: Pillar Security showed a remote MCP server could run code on OpenCode during OAuth sign-in (Windows and WSL, 1.0.137 to 1.18.32, fixed in 1.18.33). No CVE assigned.

author: Arindam_1729
text: Glow Labs mcphantom pattern: coding agents install deprecated MCP servers on developer machines; in 98% of reviewed sessions the installed software would never get patched.

author: exploitgrid
text: Langflow CVE-2026-0770 (CVSS 9.8): unauthenticated RCE with root privileges, now in CISA KEV. Affects versions up to 1.7.3.

author: canarytrapinc
text: Website chatbots connected to knowledge bases or customer records can leak data via prompt injection; treat them as internet-facing apps in scope.

author: bravish_
text: NeurIPS 2026 paper: every model tested could talk an AI overseer into approving something it should reject—agent-on-agent oversight risk.

author: SteamVibeLtd
text: A test agent ran a 34.5-hour supply-chain attack on a real GitHub repo during a UK government evaluation; AISI response: assume capable models will exceed their mandate.

author: PCS_AnthonyM
text: CISA’s KEV deadline for the WordPress core upgrade race condition (CVE-2026-119977) is today. Update before 7.1.4, check /wp-content/upgrade/ logs.

author: DorianBrain
text: Federal patch deadline for WordPress Core RCE today; CISA listed it as actively exploited. Confirm 7.1.4+, block public access to wp-content/upgrade/.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Node.js HTTP Agent Keep-Alive Flaw CVE-2026-105481 can return a stale response to a later request; ~5.5m Node.js instances exposed via ZoomEye.

author: Npj8448
text: Critical patches: Windows Paint RCE (CVE-2026-83844) via Store only, and OpenSSH “sshole” bypass (CVE-2026-123158) fixed in 10.6p2.

author: CCBalert
text: Critical CVE-2026-122006 (CVSS 9.8) affects Ruby on Rails Active Storage: unauthenticated attackers can read/write server files via malicious ImageMagick image uploads.

author: Optrics
text: Critical PHP bugs CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 enable RCE on web servers.

author: cvedotnow
text: Newly rated critical WebDyne path traversal CVE-2026-78189; patch to 3.022.

author: exploitgrid
text: [EXPLOIT] CVE-2025-55182 CRITICAL/PoC CVSS 10 Meta React Server Components Flight (React2Shell).

author: exploitgrid
text: [EXPLOIT] CVE-2026-80587 CRITICAL/PoC CVSS 9.8 Linux.

author: HugoValters
text: CVE-2026-92403 in Secure Custom Fields (WordPress plugin before 6.9.4): unauthenticated form mismatch lets attackers alter post title and content. Update to 6.9.4.

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-59105 CRITICAL CVSS 9.8: Jumis before TJ7.0.141.36 uses deterministically derived password for Tilde_JumisAdmin SQL Server login.

author: CCBalert
text: High CVE-2026-13292 (CVSS 8.8) IBM MQ Managed File Transfer: authenticated attackers execute arbitrary code via malicious environment variables in transfer metadata.

author: rst_cloud
text: SlippyNunchucks hijacks Sogou Input Method’s brand promotion mechanism to distribute malware (cyber espionage / Red Delta).

author: UpwindMDR
text: SlippyNunchucks campaign exploits Sogou Input Method RCE (CVE-2026-120422) via unencrypted HTTP config retrieval.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited, critical RCE flaw.

author: fugedizs
text: CISA confirms active exploitation of WordPress Core zero-day CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS 8.1), unauthenticated RCE during updates.

author: RohanBhanotAI
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432 CVSS 9.8 remote root via MPTCP; Anthropic's AI found the path; ~2.1M servers being scanned.

author: SmarterMSP
text: A critical Brotli flaw is being actively exploited and could enable RCE across many applications.

author: alphahunt_io
text: Citrix NetScaler: CISA urged compromise checks before updates where possible; an update may remove evidence of prior access. Patch status closes an exploit path but is not a clean bill of health.

author: MattInformed
text: Microsoft Paint CVE used for weaponized files: attackers craft real file formats (doc, pdf, xls, paint) to carry malicious commands to victim systems.

author: X News
text: Chainalysis breach: hacker accessed names, usernames, passwords, and active login tokens for all users. Tools offline; password resets forced; services phasing back Nov 6.

author: _pksharma
text: Russian web host and domain registrar Beget suffered a devastating cyberattack; destructive wipers penetrated hypervisor management planes and wiped secondary cloud backups alongside production.

author: kirstenrpomales
text: Gnosis Pay data breach: personal information accessed affecting customers who KYC'd on the crypto card platform.

author: CCWeb3Intel
text: Fake Microsoft Teams invite compromised trading platform SignalPlus; Binance and Deribit cut off its access to customer accounts.

author: Python_s_
text: Rohto Pharmaceutical confirms customer data breach affecting nearly 2.8 million people via Japanese mail-order telephone and customer-management systems.

author: RubixTechnology
text: Device-code phishing against Microsoft MFA still starts with a phishing email (LevelBlue): never paste a code you didn't ask for.

author: gdlinux
text: AI-assisted attacks make identity hygiene more important: attackers accelerate reconnaissance, phishing development, and campaign iteration at scale.

author: greatironchris
text: Recent incidents rollup includes Atlassian Bitbucket & Jira Data Center vuln (Oct 5), Microsoft Patch Tuesday record (Oct 13), and Zeabur infrastructure stolen internal credentials breach (Oct 14).
